title: wallet checks of served issuer data
property: checkIssuerData through a mutating IssuerDataSource returns only for the exact anchored canonical epoch statement with a path whose root is the anchored root and a revocation opening against the anchored revRoot; otherwise it throws WalletRefusal naming a WALLET_CHECKS check, and the refusal text never contains the credID, the leaf index or the data source's own error text (review round 2, VRA-1)

slow.basis: max(1000 ms, 100 x median call time of the first 200 cases); not a timing result

callTimeMs.note: time of the call(s) under test, for the slow-input detector only; not a timing result (untimed series, no quiet-machine protocol)
